explicit_non_rules: No independent random infection, contagion, medicine or delayed cure state in traced health path.
No sickness HP drain, movement penalty or reduced maximum HP.
No wellness gate on natural healing or stored milk.
Existing chicken production budget remains usable while sick.
Low freedom alone never freezes baby age.
Do not infer sick visuals for mooshroom from Cow inheritance; registered renderer is separate.
Do not extend livestock health to wolves,cats,horses,bats,squid or unsupported modern animals.
modern_adaptation_requirements: Reuse supplied pack sick body textures for four source renderer species; retain native models/layers.
Modern mooshroom variants retain native visuals; source renderer has no illness branch.
Keep client render classes out of dedicated-server class loading.
Existing modern synced three-resource view derives source watcher-equivalent health.
evidence_limits: Readonly source/class audit only; not modern GameTest or live client visual proof.
No complete decompiled source bodies exported.
032 baseline coverage based on inspected current code; report 033 test results separately.

binary_full_archive_audit.limitation: Constant-pool search supports the completed call-chain trace; strings alone are not treated as activated behavior.
